summary: 正常滚轮输入后的近镜成立；在该固定三分之四视角，可辨认一次自然开眼→闭合过渡→闭眼→开启过渡→睁开的过程，已查看五张1440×900原帧。闭眼帧未见明显眼白漏出。仅接受该有限可见范围。

framing.measurement: Approximate visual extent in original 1440x900 frame, not an instrumented camera-distance measurement.
framing.normalInput: Two real 600px right drags, then eight deltaY=-120 wheel pulses after normalized-scroll sensitivity correction. No Unity transform or animation state injection.

findings: 两眼在开眼与重新睁开帧可见；中间闭眼帧有覆盖，未见明显眼白漏出或与脸分离。
该顺序来自自然待机，未禁用眨眼或指定眼睑状态。
眼裂仍较窄、面部造型简化，不能把本次功能性可见性通过解释为整体审美目标已达成。

timeCut.limit: Stream copy seeks to prior keyframe; actual start40.960s includes late camera settling before the idle window. No re-encoding; no claim of an exact15s clip.

reviewerMethod: Inspected at-50 and five original-size PNG frames extracted from full video. A 240x200 face crop sequence and pixel count only located candidates; acceptance was based on the original frames. No exhaustive playback or all-angle audit.
containerCadenceLimit: 25fps is encoded browser video cadence, not game-engine FPS. Sampling/compression can hide brief intermediate geometry defects.
limitations: Only one natural blink at one fixed three-quarter camera angle is accepted; other angles, every intermediate eyelid state, all expressions and full gait are not covered.
At roughly110px face height, fine lid edges, tiny intersections and detailed skin/cloth quality cannot be judged reliably.
Full15s video was not exhaustively reviewed frame-by-frame; five selected original blink frames plus one framing frame were actually viewed.
Natural head/cloth motion and video compression remain; there is no deterministic freeze-pose comparison here.
Actual camera distance was not read; near framing is visually confirmed rather than asserting an exact2.5m measurement.
Recording and stream-copy cadence are not FPS or sustained-performance evidence.
